Supply $25 of USDC as collateral to BIMA CDP on Bitcoin and keep the position open. Cost: $25 of capital plus about $3 of gas. Time: 15 minutes.
Borrow roughly 35% of the collateral value against it and hold the borrow with the health factor above 1.5. Cost: about $3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.
Repay and re-borrow a small amount once every two weeks for 5 weeks so the activity is counted across snapshots. Cost: about $3 of gas every two weeks. Time: 15 minutes every two weeks.

Before unwinding, claim any points or rewards only from BIMA CDP's own page, then log the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm ledger. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
